stateDir.description: Directory holding the server's database and other state.

listenHost.description: Address the WebSocket server listens on.

listenPort.description: Port the WebSocket server listens on; 0 picks a free port.

providers.description: OpenAI Responses endpoints by provider id, each with its base URL, the protected file of its API key, and its models by upstream model id.

defaultModel.description: The <provider>/<model> id sessions start with when neither the request nor the agent names a model.

auxiliaryModels.description: Optional <provider>/<model> ids for the handoff, compaction, and research tasks.

origins.description: Browser origins allowed to open a WebSocket connection.

githubClientId.description: Client ID of the GitHub OAuth app the owner signs in through.

githubClientSecretFile.description: Path of the protected file holding the GitHub OAuth app's client secret.

githubCallbackUrl.description: The server's sign-in callback URL, <server origin>/v1/auth/github/callback, as the OAuth app registers it.

githubOwnerId.description: Numeric GitHub user ID of the owner, the only account that signs in.

githubUrl.description: Base URL of GitHub's authorize and token endpoints.

githubApiUrl.description: Base URL of GitHub's REST API.

devWebAllowedHosts.description: Host names the development web server answers besides its loopback address.

devWebServerUrl.description: WebSocket endpoint the development web client connects to.

permission.description: Permission rules in opencode's shape; a tool call no rule matches is allowed.

shellEnvFile.description: Optional script every shell command sources before it runs.

shellYieldMs.description: Milliseconds a shell command runs before it yields, unless its call says otherwise.

shellMaxOutputTokens.description: Estimated tokens a shell result holds, unless its call says otherwise.

shellMaxProcesses.description: Shell processes a session holds at most.

instructionsFile.description: Global instructions file, the user instructions of sessions whose agent has no title file.

agents.description: Agents by title, each with an optional starting model, per-model setting overrides, and permission rules; the key untitled is reserved.

defaultAgent.description: Optional title of the agent sessions created without one run as; the synthetic untitled title is not configurable.

titlesDir.description: Directory of title files, <title>.md, holding each agent's description and user instructions.

scratchRoot.description: Directory holding each session's scratch directory, for reproducible and disposable files.

userTimeZone.description: The user's IANA time zone, in which session facts give the user's date.

skillRoots.description: Directories searched for skills, the first winning a duplicate name.

mcpServers.description: MCP servers by name: stdio commands or Streamable HTTP URLs.

codeModeLimits.description: Optional limits on a code mode program's tool calls and output bytes.

contentMaxOriginalBytes.description: Largest submitted original file the harness accepts.

contentMaxImageBytes.description: Largest submitted image original the harness accepts.

contentMaxAttachments.description: Most attachments one submission may hold.

contentMaxSubmissionBytes.description: Largest combined original bytes one submission may hold.

contentCollectionBytes.description: Bytes a tool producer may collect before recording capture loss.

contentPreviewLines.description: Lines of oversized retained text a model observation includes.

contentPreviewBytes.description: Bytes of oversized retained text a model observation includes.

contentPdfPagesPerWindow.description: Most PDF pages one fallback model observation includes.

contentPdfDpi.description: Dots per inch used to render fallback PDF pages.

contentPdfMaxLongEdge.description: Longest pixel edge of one rendered PDF page.

contentPdfMaxPixelsPerPage.description: Most pixels one rendered PDF page may allocate.

contentPdfDocumentTokens.description: Estimated token allowance for one native PDF contribution.

contentImageTokens.description: Estimated token allowance for one model-facing image.

contentUploadQuotaBytes.description: Unclaimed upload staging bytes allowed for one owner.

contentUploadExpiryMs.description: Milliseconds after creation that unclaimed upload staging expires.

contentUploadChunkBytes.description: Largest bytes one upload append may send.

conversionPrlimitPath.description: util-linux prlimit executable that launches conversion workers.

conversionDataLimitBytes.description: RLIMIT_DATA private-allocation ceiling for one conversion worker.

conversionStackLimitBytes.description: RLIMIT_STACK ceiling for one conversion worker.

conversionCpuSeconds.description: RLIMIT_CPU seconds for one conversion worker.

conversionWallMs.description: Milliseconds after launch when the parent terminates a conversion worker.

conversionOutputBytes.description: Largest result bytes one conversion worker may return.

conversionActiveWorkers.description: Conversion workers the harness runs concurrently.

conversionQueuedJobs.description: Reference-only conversion jobs the harness queues.

communicationWaitMinMs.description: Shortest accepted session wait, in milliseconds; shorter requests clamp.

communicationWaitDefaultMs.description: session.wait timeout when the call omits one, in milliseconds.

communicationWaitMaxMs.description: Longest accepted session wait, in milliseconds; longer requests fail.

sqlite3Path.description: Official sqlite3 executable used for bounded read-only session discovery.

toolTimeoutMs.description: Elapsed milliseconds one tool invocation may take, including validation, permission waits, and effects.

toolTimeoutOverrides.description: Elapsed-time limits by exact registered tool name; null disables a tool's local limit.

exaBaseUrl.description: Base URL of the Exa API behind the web tools.

exaApiKeyFile.description: Optional path of the protected file holding the Exa API key; without it the web tools are off.

tracesExporter.description: Trace exporter: otlp, console, or none.

metricsExporter.description: Metric exporter: otlp, console, or none.

logsExporter.description: Log exporter: otlp, console, or none.

otlpEndpoint.description: OTLP endpoint the otlp exporters send to.

otlpHeadersFile.description: Optional path of the protected file holding OTLP export headers as key=value pairs.

deploymentEnvironment.description: Value of the deployment.environment.name telemetry attribute.
